name: Ren Aizawa
tagline: I build quiet, dependable services — and I'm learning to shape the interface in front of them.
about: I'm a backend developer with four years of experience designing APIs, data models, and background processing for fintech and e-commerce products. I care about clear contracts, boring reliability, and leaving fewer moving parts behind than I found.
These days I'm working through the other half of the stack — React, CSS systems, and interaction design — so I can carry a feature from the database row all the way to the button that changes it.
